claim.statement: Current Lovable publishing documentation says project changes are not automatically deployed to a live URL and that a user must choose Publish or Update to deploy a snapshot, with project and website access controlled separately.

source.title: Publish your Lovable project
source.locator: How publishing works in Lovable and project versus website access FAQ

limitations: This explicit publish gate does not prevent other configured repository synchronization and does not prove a deployment occurred.
unknowns: Publish state, snapshot, live URL, project access, website access and actor are unknown.
